sonnet.problem: The answer 'sackcloth' was already shown before this question. Card 8 says the Ninevites 'dress in sackcloth' and card 9's question repeats 'dress in sackcloth'. A baker can fill the blank from those cards without reasoning, so the fill-in-the-blank gives away its own answer and re-uses a fact already shown.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
